seo_desc: Calculate commissions for your sales team or distributors instantly. We develop custom databases for flawless settlements and financial control.
author_pitch: I have seen distributors and agencies lose thousands of euros a month due to human errors when cross-referencing spreadsheets. My goal is to design precise databases that calculate every cent of your sales instantly, ensuring you pay and get paid fairly.
title: Commission Database: Eliminate the Chaos of Your Sales Settlements
body:
Does your administration manager lose the first week of every month cross-referencing spreadsheets to pay salespeople?

Managing settlements in an SME or distribution agency is a nightmare when each sales rep has a different percentage, there are special discounts per client, or brands pay you different volume tiers. Doing this data cross-referencing by hand causes constant mathematical errors, arguments with your sales team, and a massive loss of valuable time that should be spent acquiring new clients, not fighting broken formulas.

The trap of spreadsheets for vital data

Relying on a generic file that any employee can accidentally modify means a simple typo could cost you thousands of euros in overpayments or destroy the trust of your best salespeople. Managing your company's money in a fragile document is a financial time bomb.

Our solution: Custom Database for Settlements

At LANZAESTUDIO we build a custom system from scratch, designing a robust database architecture that centralizes all your business variables and calculates margins in real time, without manual intervention.

  1. Dynamic Percentage Matrices: We configure precise rules per salesperson, product category, brand, or client, automatically calculating the exact amount on every transaction.
  2. Direct Sales Synchronization: The system extracts paid invoices directly from your management software, eliminating the need to copy and paste figures at month-end.
  3. Commercial Transparency Dashboards: Each salesperson has their own private access to see how much they have earned in the month, boosting motivation and eliminating constant questions to your office.
  4. Payment Summary Generation: With a single click, the software issues detailed settlement documents ready to be sent to your bank or accountant.

The Real Impact on Your SME Administration

  • Days of Work Saved: What used to take a whole week of cross-referencing data is now resolved and audited in a matter of minutes.
  • Zero Financial Leaks: We eradicate duplicated or miscalculated payments, ensuring your company's profit margin is always protected.
  • Peace of Mind and Trust: Your commercial team blindly trusts the numbers because the system is transparent, impartial, and free of human errors.
